questions.question: `/etc/shadow` va `/etc/passwd` farqi.
questions.explanation: /etc/passwd — umumiy user metadata (nom, UID, GID, home, shell), hamma o'qiy oladi; /etc/shadow — parol hash'lari va muddat siyosati, faqat root o'qiydi.

questions.question: `/etc/group` va `/etc/gshadow` nima?
questions.explanation: /etc/group — guruh a'zoliklari; /etc/gshadow — xavfsiz guruh parollari va administratorlari.

questions.question: PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) nima?
questions.explanation: Linux servislari bo'ylab moslashuvchan autentifikatsiya mexanizmi (/etc/pam.d/) — MFA, LDAP, parol murakkabligi qoidalarini dinamik ulash.

questions.question: `nscd` nima?
questions.explanation: Name service bazalari (passwd, group, hosts) so'rovlarini cache'lab, LDAP/NIS yukini kamaytiradigan daemon (zamonaviy alternativ: sssd).

questions.question: `glibc` va `musl libc` farqi.
questions.explanation: Standart C kutubxonasi implementatsiyalari:

questions.question: Dynamic linker (`ld.so` / `ld-linux.so`) nima?
questions.explanation: Executable'ga kerakli shared library'larni (.so) runtime'da topib xotiraga yuklaydi (ldd binary — dependency'lar).

questions.question: `/etc/ld.so.conf` va `ldconfig` nima?
questions.explanation: /etc/ld.so.conf — shared library papkalari ro'yxati; ldconfig qidiruv cache'ini (/etc/ld.so.cache) quradi.

questions.question: `chattr +i` (immutable bit) nima?
questions.explanation: Faylni o'zgarmas qiladi — o'zgartirish, o'chirish, qayta nomlash, link qilish mumkin emas, hatto root ham (avval chattr -i kerak).

questions.question: `lsattr` nima?
questions.explanation: Fayllarning ext atributlarini (immutable i, append-only a) ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: Fayl tizimi quota (`edquota`, `repquota`) nima?
questions.explanation: Foydalanuvchi yoki guruh ishlatishi mumkin bo'lgan disk joyi (block) va inode sonini cheklash.

questions.question: `/dev/urandom` va `/dev/random` farqi.
questions.explanation: /dev/random: eski kernel'larda entropiya kam bo'lsa bloklanardi (5.6+ da faqat init'gacha).

questions.question: Kernel entropy pool nima?
questions.explanation: Tasodifiy son generatsiyasi uchun ishlatiladigan hardware shovqini to'plami (interrupt vaqtlari, disk, hardware RNG).

questions.question: `tune2fs` nima?
questions.explanation: ext2/3/4 parametrlarini sozlaydi: reserved block foizi, fsck'gacha mount soni, label.

questions.question: `dumpe2fs` nima?
questions.explanation: ext4 superblock va block group metadata'sini batafsil chiqaradi.

questions.question: `xfs_info` va `xfs_repair` nima?
questions.explanation: xfs_info: XFS geometriyasi va allocation group'lari.

questions.question: `fsck` nima?
questions.explanation: Fayl tizimi yaxlitligini tekshirib, buzilgan inode jadvallari va bog'lanmagan block'larni tuzatadi (mount qilingan FS'da ishlatmang).

questions.question: Block qurilmaning major va minor raqamlari nima?
questions.explanation: Major: qurilma driver'ini aniqlaydi (masalan 8 — SCSI/SATA disklar).

questions.question: `udev` va `/etc/udev/rules.d/` nima?
questions.explanation: Hardware ulanganda /dev/ da qurilma node'larini dinamik yaratadigan va custom qoidalarni (barqaror nom, ruxsat) bajaradigan device manager.

questions.question: `lsblk` va `blkid` nima?
questions.explanation: lsblk: block qurilmalar va mount nuqtalari daraxti.

questions.question: `hdparm` va `smartctl` nima?
questions.explanation: hdparm: SATA diskni sozlash va o'qish tezligini sinash.

questions.question: `nvme-cli` nima?
questions.explanation: NVMe SSD'lar bilan ishlash utilitasi: format, firmware yangilash, namespace yaratish, xato log'lari, smart-log.

questions.question: Linux I/O scheduler'lari (mq-deadline, kyber, bfq, none) qanday?
questions.explanation: Block I/O so'rovlari tartibini belgilaydi:

questions.question: `ionice` nima?
questions.explanation: Process I/O scheduling klassi va prioritetini o'rnatadi (Idle, Best-effort, Real-time): ionice -c 3 ./backup.sh — backup faqat disk bo'sh bo'lganda (bfq/cfq bilan ishlaydi).

questions.question: Direct I/O (`O_DIRECT`) nima?
questions.explanation: Page cache'ni butunlay chetlab, user buffer va qurilma orasida bevosita o'qish/yozish — DB'lar double caching'dan qochish uchun ishlatadi (alignment talab qiladi).

questions.question: AIO va `io_uring` farqi.
questions.explanation: AIO (libaio): eski asinxron interfeys, amalda faqat O_DIRECT block I/O uchun.

questions.question: `kswapd` nima?
questions.explanation: Xotira watermark'larini kuzatib, bo'sh xotira low dan tushganda page cache'ni bo'shatadigan yoki swap qiladigan fon kernel thread'i.

questions.question: Memory compaction nima?
questions.explanation: Ajratilgan sahifalarni ko'chirib, uzluksiz bo'sh fizik xotira bloklarini hosil qilish — katta (high-order) allokatsiyalar, HugePages uchun.

questions.question: SLAB, SLUB va SLOB allocator'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel'ning tez-tez ishlatiladigan kichik obyektlari (inode, dentry) uchun cache allokatorlari; SLUB — zamonaviy default (SLAB va SLOB yangi kernel'lardan olib tashlangan).

questions.question: `/proc/meminfo` dagi `MemAvailable`, `Buffers`, `Cached`, `Dirty` nima?
questions.explanation: MemAvailable: swap'siz yangi ilovalar uchun mavjud xotira bahosi (qaytarib olinadigan cache bilan) — "free" emas, shunga qarang.

questions.question: `/proc/slabinfo` va `slabtop` nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel slab cache sarfini obyekt turi bo'yicha (dentry, inode_cache) real vaqtda ko'rsatadi — kernel xotira "oqishi"ni topish uchun.

questions.question: Dentry cache nima?
questions.explanation: Papka yo'li lookup'larini (/var/log/nginx/access.log) inode raqamlariga map qiluvchi kernel cache — fayl qidiruvini tezlashtiradi.

questions.question: `drop_caches` nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel'ni toza page cache, dentry va inode'larni darhol bo'shatishga majburlaydi: sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches. Faqat test/diagnostika uchun — prod'da unumdorlikni tushiradi.

questions.question: HugePages (`vm.nr_hugepages`) nima?
questions.explanation: Fizik RAM'da oldindan ajratilgan, swap qilinmaydigan 2MB yoki 1GB statik bloklar (Oracle, PostgreSQL huge_pages, DPDK).

questions.question: POSIX shared memory (`shm_open`, `/dev/shm`) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta mustaqil process bir xil fizik RAM segmentini o'z manzil maydoniga map qilib, mikrosekundlarda ma'lumot almashadigan IPC mexanizmi.

questions.question: Memory-mapped fayllar (`mmap`) nima?
questions.explanation: Faylni process virtual manzil maydoniga bevosita map qilish; xotiraga o'qish/yozish page cache orqali avtomatik disk o'qish va lazy yozishni chaqiradi.

questions.question: `fork()` dagi Copy-on-Write nima?
questions.explanation: Child parent'ning fizik sahifalarini read-only sifatida bo'lishadi; parent yoki child sahifaga yozgandagina nusxa olinadi (Redis BGSAVE shunga tayanadi).

questions.question: `vfork()`, `fork()` va `clone()` farqi.
questions.explanation: fork(): CoW xotira bilan child process.

questions.question: POSIX thread va Linux process farqi.
questions.explanation: Kernel'da ikkalasi ham bir xil struktura (task_struct). Thread — bir xil virtual xotira (CLONE_VM) va FD jadvalini (CLONE_FILES) bo'lishadigan clone() task'lari.

questions.question: Thread-Local Storage (TLS) nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p thread'li process'da har thread statik/global o'zgaruvchining o'z xususiy nusxasini saqlaydigan xotira hududi.

questions.question: Voluntary va involuntary context switch farqi.
questions.explanation: Voluntary: process I/O kutib CPU'ni o'zi bo'shatadi (sleep(), tarmoq read).

questions.question: `/proc/cpuinfo` nima?
questions.explanation: Protsessor arxitekturasi, yadro soni, cache hajmlari, CPU flag'lari (avx512) va hardware zaiflik mitigatsiyalari haqida ma'lumot (lscpu qulayroq).

questions.question: CPU governor (`cpufreq`) nima?
questions.explanation: CPU chastotasini dinamik boshqaradi: performance (maksimal), powersave, ondemand/schedutil. Latency'ga sezgir server'lar uchun performance.

questions.question: CPU C-state va P-state farqi.
questions.explanation: C-state: bo'sh turgandagi quvvat tejash holatlari (C0 — aktiv; chuqurroq C-state'dan uyg'onish latency qo'shadi).

questions.question: IRQ va `/proc/interrupts` nima?
questions.explanation: Qurilmalar (NIC, disk) e'tibor talab qilganda CPU'ga yuboradigan hardware signallari; /proc/interrupts — har CPU bo'yicha interrupt soni.

questions.question: SMP IRQ affinity nima?
questions.explanation: NIC interrupt'larini ma'lum yadrolarga bog'lash (/proc/irq/<N>/smp_affinity) — interrupt ishlovini taqsimlash (irqbalance).

questions.question: SoftIRQ nima?
questions.explanation: Tez hardware IRQ rejalashtirgan og'ir ishlarni (tarmoq paketlarini qabul qilish) ksoftirqd/N thread'larida bajaradigan kechiktirilgan kernel handler'lari.

questions.question: NIC RX/TX ring buffer (`ethtool -g`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kiruvchi va chiquvchi paketlar driver qayta ishlashidan oldin navbatda turadigan NIC aylanma buffer'lari; kattalashtirish burst'larda paket yo'qolishini kamaytiradi (ethtool -G).

questions.question: `ethtool` nima?
questions.explanation: NIC driver parametrlari, link tezligi, auto-negotiation, offload funksiyalari va statistikasini (-S) ko'rish/sozlash.

questions.question: MTU mos kelmasligi va IP fragmentatsiya nima?
questions.explanation: Paket oraliq router MTU'sidan katta va DF bit qo'yilgan bo'lsa, router uni tashlab ICMP "Fragmentation Needed" qaytaradi. ICMP bloklangan bo'lsa PMTUD ishlamaydi va ulanish osiladi ("black hole") — kichik so'rovlar is...

questions.question: Network namespace (`ip netns`) nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq qurilmalari, routing, firewall qoidalari va portlarni mustaqil sandbox'larga ajratish (container tarmog'ining asosi).

questions.question: Veth qurilma nima?
questions.explanation: Ikki network namespace orasida ikki tomonlama tunnel bo'lgan virtual point-to-point "quvur" (container ↔ bridge).

questions.question: Linux bridge nima?
questions.explanation: MAC jadvaliga ko'ra ulangan interfeyslar orasida Ethernet frame'larni uzatadigan dasturiy L2 switch (docker0, cni0).

questions.question: MACVLAN va IPVLAN farqi.
questions.explanation: MACVLAN: bitta fizik NIC ustida har sub-interfeysga alohida MAC va IP.

questions.question: TUN va TAP qurilmalari farqi.
questions.explanation: TUN (L3): IP paketlar bilan ishlaydi (OpenVPN, WireGuard).

questions.question: FRRouting (FRR) nima?
questions.explanation: Linux serverlar uchun BGP, OSPF, IS-IS daemon'larini beruvchi ochiq routing protokol to'plami.

questions.question: TCP SYN cookies algoritmi qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: SYN queue to'lganda kernel SYN-ACK ning boshlang'ich sequence raqamini (IP, portlar, vaqt, MSS) dan kriptografik hash qilib hisoblaydi va holat saqlamaydi; ulanish faqat client ACK kelganda tiklanadi — SYN flood'ga qa...

questions.question: TCP Fast Open (`tcp_fastopen=3`) nima?
questions.explanation: Qaytgan client'larga ma'lumotni boshlang'ich SYN ichida yuborishga ruxsat beradi (cookie bilan) — handshake latency kamayadi; middlebox'lar muammo qilishi mumkin.

questions.question: TCP SACK va D-SACK nima?
questions.explanation: SACK — qabul qiluvchi tartibsiz kelgan paketlarni tasdiqlaydi (faqat yo'qolganlar qayta yuboriladi); D-SACK — yuboruvchiga dublikat qabul qilinganini bildiradi.

questions.question: TCP CUBIC va BBR farqi.
questions.explanation: CUBIC: yo'qotishga asoslangan standart algoritm; paket yo'qolsa oynani keskin kamaytiradi.

questions.question: `SO_BINDTODEVICE` socket opsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Socket'ni aniq interfeysga (eth1) bog'laydi — route jadvalidan qat'i nazar trafik shu qurilma orqali (VRF, multi-homed hostlar).

questions.question: `TCP_NODELAY` (Nagle algoritmini o'chirish) nima?
questions.explanation: Kichik payload'larni ACK kutib bufer qilmasdan darhol yuboradi — past latency'li RPC va interaktiv protokollar uchun zarur.

questions.question: `TCP_CORK` nima?
questions.explanation: Qisman paketlarni to'liq MSS frame'larga yig'ib keyin yuboradi — fayl uzatishda throughput maksimal.

questions.question: `/proc/net/dev` nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha interfeyslar bo'yicha bayt/paket uzatish-qabul statistikasi va xato/drop soni.

questions.question: `/proc/net/snmp` va `/proc/net/netstat` nima?
questions.explanation: Tizim bo'yicha TCP/UDP/IP telemetriyasi: retransmission, reset, abort, listen queue overflow (nstat bilan o'qish qulay).

questions.question: Kernel modul imzosini tekshirish (`CONFIG_MODULE_SIG`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel faqat ishonchli kalit bilan imzolangan modullarni (.ko) yuklaydi — zararli rootkit modullari bloklanadi.

questions.question: Kernel lockdown rejimi (`integrity` va `confidentiality`) nima?
questions.explanation: Secure Boot faol bo'lganda root'ning ham ishlab turgan kernel xotirasini o'zgartirishi, xom MSR/PCIe registrlarga kirishi yoki /dev/mem ni o'qishini cheklaydi; confidentiality kernel xotirasini o'qishni ham taqiqlaydi.

questions.question: KASLR nima?
questions.explanation: Boot'da kernel kodi va ma'lumot strukturalari joylashuvini tasodifiylashtiradi — kernel exploit'larini qiyinlashtiradi.

questions.question: Seccomp-BPF arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Syscall filtr qoidalari BPF bytecode'ga compile qilinadi va har syscall'dan oldin kernel ichida baholanadi (allow, errno, kill).

questions.question: Landlock LSM nima?
questions.explanation: Imtiyozsiz ilovalarga root'siz o'zining fayl tizimi va tarmoq kirishini cheklash imkonini beradigan sandbox moduli.

questions.question: IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture) nima?
questions.explanation: Executable va kernel modullarini bajarishdan oldin hash'ini o'lchaydi va tekshiradi (appraisal) — o'zgartirilgan binary'lar bloklanadi.

questions.question: TPM 2.0 va measured boot nima?
questions.explanation: Har boot bosqichi (UEFI, GRUB, kernel) o'lchovlarini PCR registrlariga yozadigan hardware chip; disk shifrlash kalitlarini shu holatga "muhrlaydi" — boot zanjiri o'zgarsa kalit ochilmaydi.

questions.question: LUKS va `cryptsetup` nima?
questions.explanation: Linux'da to'liq disk shifrlash standarti (AES-XTS), cryptsetup bilan boshqariladi; bir nechta key slot.

questions.question: Clevis va Tang (NBDE) nima?
questions.explanation: LUKS shifrlangan disklarni boot'da ishonchli ichki tarmoqdagi Tang serveri orqali parolsiz avtomatik ochish (disk o'g'irlansa tarmoqdan tashqarida ochilmaydi).

questions.question: systemd servis sandboxing direktivalari qanday?
questions.explanation: Unit fayldagi hardening:

questions.question: systemd socket activation nima?
questions.explanation: systemd socket'ni servis nomidan tinglaydi; client ulanganda servisni talab bo'yicha ishga tushirib tayyor socket'ni uzatadi — bo'sh holatda xotira sarfi yo'q, restart'da ulanishlar yo'qolmaydi.

questions.question: systemd slice va resurs nazorati nima?
questions.explanation: Servislarni cgroup slice'larga (system.slice, user.slice) guruhlab qat'iy limitlar (MemoryMax=2G, CPUQuota=200%) qo'yish.

questions.question: systemd transient unit (`systemd-run`) nima?
questions.explanation: Ad-hoc buyruqni cgroup limitlari bilan kuzatiladigan systemd servisi sifatida ishga tushirish (systemd-run -p MemoryMax=1G cmd).

questions.question: `systemd-journal-remote` nima?
questions.explanation: Journal log'larini HTTPS orqali markaziy kolektorga stream qilish.

questions.question: `kernel.pid_max` nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel ajrata oladigan maksimal PID (64-bit'da ~4 million gacha oshirish mumkin) — PID tugashining oldini olish.

questions.question: `fs.inotify.max_user_watches` nima?
questions.explanation: Foydalanuvchi process'lari (IDE, build tool, log agent) o'zgarishlarini kuzata oladigan papka/fayl soni chegarasi.

questions.question: `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range` nima?
questions.explanation: Chiquvchi ulanishlar uchun ephemeral portlar diapazoni (default 32768 60999); proxy'larda kengaytiriladi — aks holda port tugaydi.

questions.question: `net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout` nima?
questions.explanation: Socket FIN_WAIT_2 holatida qancha turishi (default 60s). TIME_WAIT davomiyligini o'zgartirmaydi (u kernel'da qat'iy 60s).

questions.question: `vm.overcommit_memory` (0, 1, 2) nima?
questions.explanation: : heuristik overcommit.

questions.question: `vm.panic_on_oom` nima?
questions.explanation: : OOM killer process'ni o'ldiradi.

questions.question: `kernel.hung_task_timeout_secs` nima?
questions.explanation: Process D holatida shuncha vaqt (default 120s) qolsa kernel dmesg'ga stack trace bilan ogohlantirish yozadi.

questions.question: `fs.file-nr` nima?
questions.explanation: Uch qiymat: ajratilgan file handle'lar, ajratilgan lekin ishlatilmayotganlar (odatda 0) va tizim maksimumi.

questions.question: File descriptor leak nima va qanday aniqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Ilova fayl/socket ochib close() qilmasligi. ls /proc/<PID>/fd | wc -l yoki Prometheus process_open_fds / process_max_fds nisbati bilan kuzatiladi.

questions.question: Thread leak nima va qanday aniqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Ilova thread yaratib ularni tugatmasligi. ps -o nlwp <PID> (thread soni) yoki /proc/<PID>/status dagi Threads bilan; Go'da goroutine leak — pprof.

questions.question: Memory leak va memory fragmentation farqi.
questions.explanation: Leak: xotira ajratiladi va unga havola yo'qoladi (yoki keraksiz havola saqlanadi) — bo'shatilmaydi, RSS doimiy o'sadi.

questions.question: `valgrind` (Memcheck) nima?
questions.explanation: Binary'ni emulyatsiyada bajarib memory leak, buffer overflow va init qilinmagan o'qishlarni topadigan tool (sekin — ~20-50x).

questions.question: `bpftrace` nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF uchun yuqori darajali tracing tili — bir qatorli skriptlar bilan prod kernel'da funksiya argumentlari, latency va syscall sonlarini ko'rish.

questions.question: `bcc-tools` nima?
questions.explanation: Tayyor eBPF diagnostika skriptlari: execsnoop, opensnoop, biolatency, tcpconnect, tcpretrans, runqlat.

questions.question: `sysstat` arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Timer/cron SAR ma'lumotlarini har 10 daqiqada binary formatda /var/log/sysstat/saDD (yoki /var/log/sa/) ga yozadi.

questions.question: `nfsstat` nima?
questions.explanation: NFS client va server statistikasi: RPC chaqiruvlar, retrans, timeout'lar.

questions.question: `autofs` nima?
questions.explanation: Papkaga murojaat qilinganda NFS/CIFS'ni avtomatik mount qiluvchi va faoliyatsizlikdan keyin unmount qiluvchi daemon (yoki systemd automount).

questions.question: `kernel.core_pattern` nima?
questions.explanation: Core dump fayl nomi va yo'li shabloni (/var/crash/core.%e.%p.%t) yoki pipe (|/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-coredump).

questions.question: `ip netns exec` nima?
questions.explanation: Buyruqni ma'lum network namespace ichida bajarish (ip netns exec net0 ping 8.8.8.8).

questions.question: Kernel livepatching (kpatch / Canonical Livepatch) nima?
questions.explanation: Kritik kernel xavfsizlik patch'larini ishlab turgan tizimda reboot'siz xotiraga qo'llash (vaqtinchalik yechim — keyinroq rejali reboot baribir kerak).

questions.question: Rootkit aniqlash (`rkhunter` / `chkrootkit`) nima?
questions.explanation: Tizim binary'lari, kernel modullari va portlarni ma'lum rootkit va backdoor'larga skanerlash.

questions.question: Prod Linux avariyasida "oltin" troubleshooting tartibi qanday?
questions.explanation: Ko'lamni aniqlash: qaysi foydalanuvchi va servislar ta'sirlangan.
